criteria.esa: the score out of a hundred the annotator gave
criteria.spans: the marked spans read as a severity-weighted tally
criteria.major-only: the marked spans, serious errors only
criteria.count: the marked spans, one point each

config.second_axis: whether a score is used as written or standardised within the annotator who wrote it
config.published_cell: the score out of a hundred, unnormalised, averaged within each domain and then across domains, which is how the task ranks; the mean over segments is a different number
